name: Tailwind
description: Grants 1% increased movement speed, 2% increased Skill Speed, 10% increased Evasion Rating and prevent 1% of Damage from Deflected Hits per stack. Maximum 10 stacks.
keywordDefinition:
Tailwind is a stacking Buff which grants 1% increased movement speed, 2% increased Skill Speed, 10% increased Evasion Rating and prevent 1% of Damage from Deflected Hits per stack. Maximum 10 stacks.

Lose all Tailwind stacks when Hit.
